scope: Manual audit of all 14 train-holdout questions where the frozen T8-6 prediction disagrees with the stored label and all 32 base generations yield the same extracted answer.
caveat: This is a targeted audit of unanimous mismatches, not a random sample of all 1,086 measured errors. Its status proportions must not be extrapolated to every error.

cases.evidence: Writing a2=x and common difference d gives (x+d)^2=x(x+4d), hence x=d/2 and a6/a3=(x+4d)/(x+d)=3.
cases.recommended_action: Quarantine from evaluation and relabel to 3 after human review.

cases.evidence: For six indistinguishable balls in four distinguishable boxes with empty boxes allowed, the nonnegative-solution count is C(9,3)=84; the prompt gives no additional restriction that produces 72.
cases.recommended_action: Quarantine from evaluation and relabel to 84 after human review.

cases.evidence: The constraint is a circle centered at (1,-2) with radius sqrt(5). Maximizing x-2y gives center value 5 plus norm sqrt(5) times radius sqrt(5), for 10.
cases.recommended_action: Keep as a hard noisy-prompt reasoning case; emphasize constrained linear optimization.

cases.evidence: There are 42+7=49 fruits and 40 left over, so 49-40=9 students received fruit.
cases.recommended_action: Quarantine from evaluation and relabel to 9 after human review.

cases.evidence: Of 30 members, 12 order lemon; one third of the remaining 18 is 6 mango, leaving 12 orange.
cases.recommended_action: Quarantine from evaluation and relabel to 12 after human review.

cases.evidence: All inspected raw generations correctly end with FINAL_ANSWER: 3 x 10^8, but the integer-only extractor falls back to the last integer and records the exponent 8.
cases.recommended_action: Strengthen the model output contract to require a canonical integer; do not add test-time arithmetic evaluation of scientific notation.

cases.evidence: (10^3+1)^2=1002001, whose digit sum is 4; the stored label is the integer itself rather than the requested digit sum.
cases.recommended_action: Quarantine from evaluation and relabel to 4 after human review.

cases.evidence: The item is a fragment followed by an instruction to translate it into English, not a well-formed single-answer math question, so the integer label cannot be audited from the request.
cases.recommended_action: Remove from exact-answer evaluation and quarantine from answer-supervised training.

cases.evidence: For an isosceles right triangle, altitude 4 to the hypotenuse implies hypotenuse 8; area=(8*4)/2=16. The stored label is the hypotenuse, not the requested area.
cases.recommended_action: Quarantine from evaluation and relabel to 16 after human review.

cases.evidence: The legs are log_5(125)=3 and log_3(81)=4, so h=5 and 5^h=3125.
cases.recommended_action: Quarantine from evaluation and relabel to 3125 after human review.

cases.evidence: There are 12 ordered pairs and the maximum x+y is 7. The stored integer 127 appears to concatenate two requested outputs and is incompatible with a single canonical answer.
cases.recommended_action: Rewrite as two separate questions or define an explicit structured answer format.

cases.evidence: The prompt embeds a worked solution that asserts n=49, but n=49 gives 552 scalene integer triangles while n=51 gives 600, matching the stored label. The model follows the contradictory solution text.
cases.recommended_action: Remove the faulty embedded solution or quarantine the item; retain 51 only with a corrected prompt.

cases.evidence: The recurrence produces the period-6 sequence 1,4,3,-1,-4,-3. Since 2023 is congruent to 1 modulo 6, b_2023=1.
cases.recommended_action: Quarantine from evaluation and relabel to 1 after human review.

cases.evidence: The stated animal counts sum to 100+80+20+200+50+200=650.
cases.recommended_action: Quarantine from evaluation and relabel to 650 after human review.
